data.one_liner: A collection of custom lint rules, quick fixes, and code assists for Flutter and Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides 261 custom lints, quick fixes, and IDE code assists using the analysis_server_plugin system. Rules span architecture, state management, async safety, and functional programming patterns.
use_when: You want custom lint rules and automated quick fixes for Flutter or Dart projects
You use fpdart and want specialized functional programming lints and refactoring assists
You want IDE-integrated code assists for refactoring patterns like collection-fors and null checks
avoid_when: Your project uses an older Dart SDK version below 3.11
You do not want to configure plugins in analysis_options.yaml
strengths: Extensive collection of over 200 lints with built-in quick fixes and code assists
Direct integration with dart analyze and IDEs via the analysis_server_plugin system
Flexible configuration with tiered presets ranging from core to pedantic
weaknesses: Plugin configuration requires placing entries in the top-level plugins section of analysis_options.yaml
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin under the top-level plugins section in analysis_options.yaml and choose a preset or enable rules.
